items.known: CKV2_AWS_6 Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Set the `acl` attribute to `private` or use a bucket policy to restrict access.

items.known: CKV_AWS_145 Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a `server_side_encryption_configuration` block to enable encryption.

items.remediation: Add a `logging` block to enable access logging.

scores.reason: Right direction, but CKV2_AWS_6 needs an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls and restrict_public_buckets set to true. Setting acl or a policy does not satisfy it.
Names the right block, but omits sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" and kms_master_key_id, which the KMS check requires.
Names the logging block, but gives no target_bucket (e.g. the logs bucket) or target_prefix.
A versioning block with enabled = true is the correct fix.
